# Mara Infra Constructions

> Building contractor in Madipakkam, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. Mara Infra builds custom homes, villas and apartment complexes, commercial buildings (schools, offices, retail outlets, warehouses, industrial units), renovation and remodeling, and sustainable buildings with solar and rainwater integration. It handles building approvals and gives a free, no-obligation estimate after a site visit.

## Key facts

- Company: Mara Infra Constructions (also written MaraInfra)
- Founders: Mr. Madhan Kumar (previously with Appasamy Builders) and Mr. Ravichandran (previously with Mark Builders)
- Experience: over 20 years in construction; 100+ completed projects, including 30+ commercial projects such as schools, multiplexes, temples, bus stands, shops and marriage halls
- Approvals handled: CMDA/DTCP building-plan approval, Panchayat/Municipality permissions, water and electricity approvals
- Office: 250, Thirugnana Sambandar Street, Srinivasa Nagar, Madipakkam, Chennai 600091
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9 a.m. to 6 p.m.; closed Sundays
- Phone: +91 99621 16999, +91 99621 76999
- Email: admin@marainfra.co.in
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mara_infra/
